Greenwood Ram.name: Greenwood Ram
Greenwood Ram.description: The user grows a bough of green wood padded with thick moss from their forearm and drives it into a target within a few strides. It deals heavy bludgeoning damage, knocks the target flat and wraps them in soothing moss that holds them still until they tear free; held back, the mossy pad absorbs the impact and only pins them to the floor unhurt. The growth needs light and water and drains the user's stamina. Strain: heavy.
